title: Agent overview
description: LLM o11y 101: what the travel-planner agent is doing and what it costs, from GenAI semconv telemetry.

config.content: **Agent overview.** Every panel is ES|QL over data the OpenTelemetry Collector derives from [GenAI semconv](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/gen-ai/) spans: `gen_ai.client.token.usage`, `gen_ai.client.operation.duration` and `travel_planner.tool.calls`. **Empty?** Those metrics only exist once spans carry `gen_ai.operation.name`, which is Lab 2.

data_source.query:
SET unmapped_fields="nullify";
FROM traces-*.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.gen_ai.operation.name == "invoke_agent" AND attributes.gen_ai.agent.name == "travel-planner"
| STATS invocations = COUNT(*)

SET unmapped_fields="nullify";
FROM metrics-genai.otel-*
| WHERE gen_ai.client.token.usage IS NOT NULL
| STATS tokens = SUM(gen_ai.client.token.usage)

SET unmapped_fields="nullify";
FROM metrics-genai.otel-*
| WHERE gen_ai.client.token.usage IS NOT NULL
| STATS tokens = SUM(gen_ai.client.token.usage) BY model = attributes.gen_ai.request.model, type = attributes.gen_ai.token.type
// Illustrative USD list prices per 1M tokens: edit to match your models and contract
| EVAL usd_per_1m = CASE(model LIKE "gpt-4o-mini*", CASE(type == "input", 0.15, 0.60), model LIKE "gpt-4.1-nano*", CASE(type == "input", 0.10, 0.40), model LIKE "gpt-4.1-mini*", CASE(type == "input", 0.40, 1.60), model LIKE "gpt-4o*", CASE(type == "input", 2.50, 10.00), CASE(type == "input", 1.00, 4.00))
| STATS cost_usd = SUM(tokens * usd_per_1m / 1000000.0)

SET unmapped_fields="nullify";
FROM metrics-genai.otel-*
| WHERE gen_ai.client.operation.duration IS NOT NULL
| STATS p95 = PERCENTILE(gen_ai.client.operation.duration, 95)

config.title: Tokens over time, by token type

data_source.query:
SET unmapped_fields="nullify";
FROM metrics-genai.otel-*
| WHERE gen_ai.client.token.usage IS NOT NULL
| STATS tokens = SUM(gen_ai.client.token.usage) BY t = BUCKET(@timestamp, 40, ?_tstart, ?_tend), token_type = attributes.gen_ai.token.type
| EVAL tokens = TO_DOUBLE(tokens)
| WHERE tokens IS NOT NULL

config.title: LLM call latency (s), p50 and p95

data_source.query:
SET unmapped_fields="nullify";
FROM metrics-genai.otel-*
| WHERE gen_ai.client.operation.duration IS NOT NULL
| STATS p50 = PERCENTILE(gen_ai.client.operation.duration, 50), p95 = PERCENTILE(gen_ai.client.operation.duration, 95) BY t = BUCKET(@timestamp, 40, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL p50 = TO_DOUBLE(p50)
| EVAL p95 = TO_DOUBLE(p95)
| WHERE p50 IS NOT NULL AND p95 IS NOT NULL

config.title: Tool calls, by tool and outcome

data_source.query:
SET unmapped_fields="nullify";
FROM metrics-genai.otel-*
| WHERE travel_planner.tool.calls IS NOT NULL
| STATS calls = SUM(travel_planner.tool.calls) BY tool = attributes.gen_ai.tool.name, outcome = attributes.error.type
| EVAL calls = TO_DOUBLE(calls)
| WHERE calls IS NOT NULL

config.title: Slowest agent runs (search a trace_id in Discover to see its timeline)

data_source.query:
SET unmapped_fields="nullify";
FROM traces-*.otel-*
| WHERE attributes.gen_ai.operation.name == "invoke_agent"
| EVAL duration_ms = ROUND(duration / 1000000.0)
| SORT duration_ms DESC
| KEEP @timestamp, attributes.gen_ai.agent.name, attributes.gen_ai.conversation.id, duration_ms, trace_id
| RENAME attributes.gen_ai.agent.name AS agent, attributes.gen_ai.conversation.id AS conversation
| LIMIT 25
